_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (the top-level single-file state, NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). Replace 'android-host' with the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname of the PC that runs android_mcp.py (Win11 or macOS).
_v0_4_note: android-gui v0.4.0 runs on a PC HOST (not the phone). The host bridges to one Android device via raw ADB (USB / Wireless / Hybrid; chosen at host setup). Single device only in v0.4.
_recommended_install: Use scripts/install-agent-side.py --platform android-gui --hostname <ANDROID_HOST_HOSTNAME> instead of editing this file by hand.
